thread:
sam: Quick sync  we're launching a pricing experiment next sprint. Need to coordinate CSV contract, grandfathering logic, and AR review triggers.

raj: I maintain the billing ingestion pipeline. What's changing in the CSV? New rate_code and a "grandfather_until" column?

sam: Yes: rate_code will reference price_v3 tiers. Planning to add grandfather_until (epoch) and a "apply_retro" boolean. For canary: 7 days, 5% traffic.

claire: For A/B: arm A = price_v2 baseline, arm B = price_v3 tiered. Important: reserved capacity customers must be excluded from A/B unless we explicitly opt them in.

ana: Legal flag: vendor agreement VC-77 prohibits unilateral price reductions that trigger rebate beyond 30 days unless consented. If we anticipate retro credits (apply_retro true), those accounts need a manual legal ok.

jordan: AR: anything that will change invoice totals > $2k needs a manual AR ticket. We also need a CSV export of items flagged for review to attach to tickets.

raj: I can add manual_review_reason and exportable_review_id columns. Also will emit a review webhook when manual_review is true. Sample CSV row: 

```
account_id,rate_code,quantity,grandfather_until,apply_retro,manual_review,manual_review_reason,review_id
A-100,price_v3_t1,120,0,true,true,delta>25pct,REV-20260301-01
```

sam: Nice. Ops gating metrics: simulated invoice drift median <10%, >95% of invoices succeed in staging, and manual-review queue < 50 items for the canary to continue. Retro liability estimate < $10k.

claire: I'll produce cohort SQL and a list of explicit excludes (reserved, VC-77 vendors). Also will generate an opt-in list for customers who requested new pricing early.

ana: I'll review vendor clauses and return a list of contract IDs that require carve-outs by EOD Thu.

jordan: I'll create the AR spreadsheet with columns: review_id,account_id,old_amount,new_amount,delta_pct,owner,notes,escalation_needed. Will add automation to create ticket when review_id appears in webhook.

billing-bot: checklist: schema-validation, review-webhook, staging-sim-invoice, cohort-exclude, legal-carveouts. All tests must pass in staging namespace.

sam: Proposed timeline: final schema Tue (2169060000), staging run Wed, canary Mon (2169664800). Approvals needed: Legal (Ana), Revenue Ops (Claire), Finance Lead signoff.

raj: I'll open PR with schema and webhook payload docs. Will include a small simulation harness to estimate retro liability.

claire: I'll produce the exclude list and the SQL for randomized 5% selection. Also will tag the list of accounts with delayed usage ingestion to skip.

sam: Action items recap: Raj 1 1 PR schema + webhook; Claire 1 cohort & excludes; Ana 1 vendor carve-out list; Jordan 1 AR sheet + ticket automation. We'll reconvene here after PR is up. :thumbsup:

raj: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/billing/price-v3/schema/compare. Running schema tests.

ana: I'll send a short template for the customer communication for grandfathered accounts. Tagging legal in the PR once ready.

jordan: AR sheet live: https://sheets.redwood.co/AR-PRICING-REVIEW-2026-03-01. Inviting owners.

sam: Thanks everyone. Flag any blockers in thread. If legal carve-outs > 20 accounts we may delay canary to handle manual processes.

claire: noted. I'll surface count in the exclude list.
